title: Frost on the ramp
logline: The ramp with frost on it in December, the pup's two-one prints melted through the frost, the shack's door shut, the string lights off by day. The prints go up; none come down.

panels.composition: A plank ramp at a shingle shack's door white with frost, a three-legged dog's prints melted through the frost going up it, the door shut, string lights unlit along the eave.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a plank ramp at a shingle shack's door white with frost with a three-legged dog's prints melted through the frost going up it, the door shut and unlit string lights along the eave, no words
